# Xolani Sibande

::: tagline
Economist · Researcher
:::

I'm an economist with over a decade of experience spanning academia, the financial sector, and government, currently working on central bank research into the impact of monetary and macroprudential policies on the broader economy.

My core areas of expertise are Econometrics, Macroeconomics, Finance, Data Science, and Public Policy.
